name: Bursting Impact raises off-hand damage by 25% (#2599)
contract: Bursting Impact 705276 applies SPELL_AURA_MOD_OFFHAND_DAMAGE_PCT for 25, which the core's HandleModOffhandDamagePercent applies to off-hand weapon damage. The harness has no off-hand damage metric, so the proof is that the aura is applied with amount 25.
